verdict.rationale: a-Shell's own `config` command changes the font, font size, background and text colors, and cursor color and shape. `config -p` makes the settings permanent for all future windows, and `config --theme ... -g` saves a theme in Settings. Custom fonts and theme files in Windows Terminal JSON format are also supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the README documentation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can customize the font, colors, and cursor appearance of my terminal and persist the settings

citations.quote: It lets you change the font, the font size, the background color, the text color and the cursor color and shape.
config -p will make the settings for the current window permanent, that is used for all future windows.
Add `-g` to update every open window and save the theme in Settings
Run `config --fonts` to register them and list available face names.
